prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and pose-transfer correction.
Asset type: one complete full-body rigid 2D Spine attack_peak production attachment for a side-view combat game.

Reference responsibilities: Image 1 is the immovable registration master for Vivhite's three-quarter screen-right camera, exact 1680-by-2512 canvas family, head size, full-body scale, pixel density, costume appearance, and edge padding. Image 2 is authoritative only for the strong empty-palm impact gesture and dynamic limb relationship; ignore its placement, misty halo, outer illumination, and close-up feeling. Image 3 is authoritative for the original magical-girl costume construction, blue butterfly ornament, body design, and color placement. Image 4 is authoritative for her facial identity, short layered silver-white bob, vivid violet-pink eyes, and thin round gold glasses.

Primary request: Redraw exactly one Vivhite at the single impact instant of a fast, forceful, empty-handed magical palm strike toward screen-right. Preserve the convincing low stance, forward palm, pulled-back counterbalancing hand, hip-and-shoulder twist, bent knees, and acceleration in Image 2, but register the finished figure to Image 1's scale and camera. This must be a newly painted coherent action figure, not Image 1 deformed and not Image 2 merely cropped or shifted. Her screen-right near arm drives almost straight toward the enemy with an open empty palm at upper-chest height; keep all five fingers clean, readable, and unobstructed as the later runtime VFX origin. Pull the far elbow beside the ribs with its empty hand open. Keep one rear boot visibly planted and driving and the front boot forward and grounded. Her eyes lock toward screen-right. Hair tips, butterfly, and skirt panels trail subtly toward screen-left while remaining attached and anatomically coherent. The physical silhouette alone must read as impact.

Hard registration contract: Match Image 1's apparent head size and character pixel density. The hair-and-head envelope should stay approximately 555 pixels wide by 425 pixels tall, never a close-up. Translate the Image 2 pose lower and farther screen-right without enlarging it. On the 1680-by-2512 canvas, target pelvis near (780,1260), head center near (900,390), eye midpoint near (960,470), screen-left rear boot contact near (486,2181), screen-right front boot contact near (1197,2475), and striking-palm center near (1510,700). These are invisible layout anchors, not marks or labels. Keep every physical pixel within x=24..1645 and y=24..2475, with clearly unused padding at all four edges. Preserve the full butterfly, hair tips, both hands and every finger, skirt, both knees, and both boot soles. Do not automatically enlarge or center the crouched pose to fill the canvas.

Style and lighting: polished 2D anime game-sprite painting, crisp controlled contours, restrained interior cel shading, matte non-emissive costume surfaces, and the same rendering detail as Image 1. Every highlight and shadow stops at the physical character contour. The area outside the physical silhouette contains no painted marks.

Constraints: one continuous figure, one pose, one view. Empty hands only. No sword, blade, staff, wand, rod, spear, spellbook, shield, orb, weapon-shaped prop, or held object. No magic arc, sigil, spell projectile, aura, halo, outer glow, bloom, rim light, detached illumination, haze, mist, smoke, or particles; those are separate runtime VFX. No floor, contact patch, cast shadow, scenery, frame, text, logo, signature, or watermark. No sprite sheet, character sheet, turnaround, panel grid, duplicate pose, extra person, extra limb, missing limb, fused fingers, broken wrist, cropped hair, cropped butterfly, cropped fingers, or cropped boots. Do not draw an upright idle stance, a swordsman stance, a frontal camera, or a weak raised-hand gesture.
